Premise: holds — read at origin/main `41164656` 2026-11-26T13:50Z. The Studio menu draws the `environment` entry (Access group, every scope) to `/studio/~all/metadata`, whose root is the type directory scoped to the environment catalog's four types; Setup's `group_access_control` has no entry for them.
Reading taken (the area may overrule it on the PR): the Setup page serves the directory and each type's environment list, re-using the metadata-admin pages, with Setup's header; an item, a create and a history still open in Studio, on the editor the environment scope uses today (`/studio/~all/metadata/TYPE/NAME?scope=environment`), because an environment item is edited by name and may belong to no package. `~all` addresses that are the directory (the root, and a type list of the four types in the environment scope) redirect once to the Setup page; the cross-package list of any other type stays where it is. Access rule unchanged: the entry and the page both require `studio.access` (today's Studio entry gate) on top of Setup's own `setup.access`. Studio's no-package fallback, which landed on the directory, lands on the package-less scope (`~org`) instead, which every Studio entrant may open.
Serial constraints cleared: #37454 (PR #37546, same two Studio menu files, merge after it lands); #37456 and #37553 hold `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, not touched here.
Governing text: `docs/adr/0084` `#amendment-2026-11-26-moves` on main, binding; question 5 ruled in record 7187264388 on #37451.
